sources.correspondence: Conjecture 21 quantifies over absolute coefficients of every chromatic polynomial; chromatic polynomial is introduced by proper coloring count. Cycles are explicitly included.
Section 13 and Conjecture 13.1 give the earlier formulation. The L operator uses square minus neighboring product and explicitly sets a(-1)=0; every positive iterate must be nonnegative.
L retains the full finite index set 0 through n and sets both external neighbors to zero. This is the convention formalized here.

limitation: No claim about publication priority or exhaustive literature novelty; only C17 under the endpoint-retaining convention is formalized.
